name: matts-second-brain
description: A persistent knowledge brain for Claude Code, backed by Trilium Notes. Standards, decisions, lessons learned, and per-app context that survive across sessions and grow over time. Includes a setup wizard, an MCP server with brain_recall / brain_remember / brain_scan_transcripts tools, and a discipline skill that makes Claude actually use it.

sessionReminder.title: Session reminder
sessionReminder.description: Inject the brain discipline at session start (knowledge-only, recall-before, capture-after). Set false to rely on the auto-loaded skill alone.

scheduledMaintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance
scheduledMaintenance.description: Run unattended nightly brain maintenance (scan transcripts, persist durable knowledge, reindex). Enable, then run /matts-second-brain:maintenance install.

maintenanceModel.title: Maintenance model
maintenanceModel.description: Model the unattended maintenance run uses.

scanSinceDays.title: Scan window (days)
scanSinceDays.description: How many days of recent transcripts the maintenance scan considers.

maintenanceTimeoutMin.title: Maintenance timeout (minutes)
maintenanceTimeoutMin.description: Hard timeout (minutes) for the unattended maintenance agent run.
